head: iPhone Handoff on iOS 27: which carriers support it and what it costs
dek: iOS 27's iPhone Handoff, which moves your number between two iPhones, works on T-Mobile ($5 a month), EE (£5) and Telekom in Germany (€6.95). Verizon says it will add it for $10 a month with no date, and AT&T has no plans.
details: Your number moves to whichever iPhone you unlock, with calls, voicemail, messages and Find My location. Both phones need iOS 27, Wi-Fi, the same Apple Account, Messages in iCloud, and FaceTime and iMessage on that account. AT&T points customers to its eSIM transfer options instead. No other carrier has promised support yet.
where: T-Mobile (US), EE (UK) and Telekom (Germany) now; Verizon later
means: If you carry two iPhones, you can keep one number on both, but only on these carriers and for a monthly fee.
todo: Check that both iPhones run iOS 27 and that Messages in iCloud is on, then ask your carrier whether it offers iPhone Handoff.
